I see the issue now! When `wrap` is truthy, my code does:
```python
s = wrap % '[^ ]*' + fill + '*'
```

But this is wrong because `wrap % '[^ ]*'` creates `([^ ]*)`, and then I'm appending `fill + '*'` after it. But `fill` might be a special character that needs escaping. And more importantly, for named fields, `wrap` is `(?P<name>%%s)`, so `wrap % '[^ ]*'` gives `(?P<name>[^ ]*)`.
